mapper.select: SELECT acc.COLUMN_NAME FROM ALL_CONSTRAINTS ac JOIN ALL_CONS_COLUMNS acc ON ac.OWNER = acc.OWNER AND ac.CONSTRAINT_NAME = acc.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE ac.OWNER = USER AND ac.TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{tableName}) AND ac.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'P' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER = USER AND TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{tableName})
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE OWNER = USER AND TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{tableName}) AND COLUMN_NAME = UPPER(#{fieldName})
